design_rules: 质量门先于业务树；任一关键质量门失败，受影响分支不得做内容归因。
指标树表达业务因果顺序和计算关系；只有标注 exact_identity 的边才可做精确乘法/加法分解。
长篇的分发、章节、回访指标分母和 cohort 不同，根节点是概念综合结果，不伪造总分。
短故事在同 story_id、period、platform_scope 下可作完整漏斗乘法分解。
channel 是维度，不将书城/分类/搜索等成员展开成重复指标。

children.name: 时效
children.gate: BLOCK if data_until is not the required cutoff or the platform has not stabilized

children.name: 完整
children.gate: BLOCK affected branch when required fields are absent or unparseable

children.name: 合法性
children.gate: BLOCK affected rate or transition until zero semantics and mathematical bounds are valid

children.name: 字段同步
children.gate: Use synchronized absolute counts or wait; never copy a stale displayed ratio

children.name: 内部一致性
children.gate: Investigate attribution/sync when balance fails; do not infer content

children.name: 版本覆盖
children.gate: NOT_COVERED => 数据未覆盖改动; PARTIAL_DAY_COVERED != 完整自然日; 时间覆盖不替代线上版本证据

children.name: 口径可比
children.gate: Incomparable observations cannot support improvement/regression judgment

children.name: 样本污染
children.gate: Confirmed contamination => 样本受自访污染; unconfirmed search dominance => ask and downgrade

children.name: 回填稳定
children.gate: Material same-cutoff backfill keeps conclusion provisional

trees.name: 长篇可持续有效阅读树
trees.formula_reason: 分发、累计章节、14日在读、7日追更和日互动的窗口/分母不一致，不能乘成一个伪综合分。

identity.condition: dq_channel_balance_gap=0 for this snapshot; this does not prove permanent mutual exclusivity

children.name: 回访与互动
children.formula_reason: 资格人群不同，不得统一除以在读或日阅读。

identity.warning: R_t-R_(t-1) is entry plus rollout net effect, not exact acquisition or churn

trees.name: 短故事有效触底漏斗树
trees.formula: short_finish_readers = short_impressions * short_click_rate * short_15s_retention * short_15s_to_30_rate * short_30s_to_60_rate * short_60s_to_finish_rate
formula_conditions: rates use raw counts rather than independently rounded displays

children.name: 展示规模
children.warning: low display alone is not a body-text diagnosis

children.name: 阅读到15秒
children.text_window: opening through approximately first 300 Chinese characters

children.name: 15到30秒
children.text_window: read from opening; focus approximately characters 300-1000

children.name: 30到60秒
children.text_window: read from opening; focus approximately characters 500-2000

children.name: 60秒到触底
children.text_window: after approximately 2000 characters through ending; inspect whole middle-to-end units

children.name: 漏斗路由辅助
children.role: select earliest material abnormal conditional stage after gates; never replaces text verification
